audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads EVEN at 6/10 and report[14] calls it an 'Even matchup', while the content layer's own late text opens 'This is lost on stats (35% WR)' and both charts give Cho'Gath four of seven stages.
audit.why: 35.0% over 20 games with the enemy owning 2, 3 and both item stages is not an even lane. Nothing Galio has threatens a Cho'Gath who is buying health, and Feast only compounds.
audit.corrected: diff HARD, diffRating 8/10, and the rating and chart summaries matched to the stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer is built on 'trade when Rupture is down' and 'respect the physical damage — build the armor side'. Both are wrong, and the one number that makes the lane playable is missing.
audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6-second cooldown at every rank — there is no window to wait for; it is dodged, not outlasted, and Riot flags it as a telegraphed ground effect. On damage type, the only thing Riot's text commits to is that Feral Scream 'deals magic damage' and Feast deals 'true damage' — nothing in the kit is stated as physical, so stacking armour is the wrong instinct. And Feral Scream, the ability that actually beats Galio by silencing the Shield of Durand channel, has a range of just 300: from Winds of War's 825 it cannot reach you.
audit.corrected: Rupture reframed as a 6s telegraph to dodge, the armour line replaced, and Feral Scream's 300 range made the spine of the trading advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why calls Stormsurge/Riftmaker your spike on a stage the chart gives Cho'Gath, phases[4].why ends with the boilerplate 'Reassess his ultimate too', and no cooldown numbers appear anywhere.
audit.why: Feral Scream 11s at rank 1, Vorpal Spikes 8s, Feast 80s at rank 1 — and Feast's stacking health is the spike that ends the lane, not an item.
audit.corrected: Stage lines rebuilt around Feral Scream's arrival at 4 and Feast at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Rupture 'matchup-defining' with no duration.
audit.why: Rupture's 6s flat cooldown is precisely why it is not the ability to track; Feral Scream's 11s at rank 1 is.
audit.corrected: Both numbers stated, with the tracking priority reversed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The loading tip ends '- Anti-heal if he sustains.'
audit.why: Cho'Gath's only health return is Carnivore, which triggers on unit kills — Grievous Wounds is not what changes this lane, and the tip wastes the one screen the player reads.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the Feral Scream range rule.

edits.before: From level 4 on he flips this lane. His W (Feral Scream) silence stops you from starting your Shield of Durand channel and from casting E, so only commit your combo when his silence is on cooldown. At 6 Feast gives him permanent bonus HP and an R that, once you are low, executes for true damage — your magic-amplified damage reduction does nothing against true damage, so the exact W-taunt-burst that shreds Akali or Diana is dead weight here. Stop trying to win the duel: use your R (Hero's Entrance) to roam bot or mid and convert this dead lane into pressure elsewhere.

notes: chogath.json flags Rupture (Q) with 'grounding', but Riot's description only gives knock-up, damage and a slow — no grounding — so I made no grounding claim about it. Riot's text does not state a damage type for Rupture or Vorpal Spikes; only Feral Scream (magic) and Feast (true) are explicit, so I removed the 'build the armor side' instruction rather than replace it with an equally unsupported MR claim, and recommended Mercury's Treads only against the confirmed magic damage. suspectNames flagged 'His Feral Scream' — that is the correct Riot name, a false positive.
